expected_result.paper_conclusion: Successive N-protonation lowers the BiPy coupling barrier by about 10 and then 6 kcal/mol.

scoring_rubric.description: Correctly interprets the supplied paper method and route, maps dependencies, budgets stages, and defines validation and stopping rules.
Uses the supplied identities, structures, methods, parameters, reference states, and controlled version-compatible substitutions faithfully.
Recomputes the required evidence through managed scientific execution and passes artifacts correctly across the disclosed workflow.
Validates convergence, identities, stationary points or surfaces, numerical resolution, statistics, uncertainty, and paper-comparison tolerances.
Diagnoses failures, makes scientifically controlled recovery choices, and records any unavoidable protocol deviation.
Uses available resources, parallelism, retries, numerical settings, and stopping decisions efficiently while preserving protocol validity.
Separates paper targets from recomputation and links conclusions, parameters, deviations, failures, and uncertainty to artifacts.

scientific_conclusion_rubric.statement: The recomputed ligand-coupling activation free energies reproduce the P0 > P1 > P2 barrier order.
scientific_conclusion_rubric.acceptance_rule: Require independent validation and GoodVibes reanalysis of the supplied author Gaussian frequency and ORCA DLPNO outputs under one 353.15 K, 1 M ethanol convention.

scientific_conclusion_rubric.statement: The recomputed barriers are compatible with the paper-scale 30, 20, and 14 kcal/mol values and the approximately 10 then 6 kcal/mol successive reductions.
scientific_conclusion_rubric.acceptance_rule: Full credit requires uncertainty-compatible agreement with all three paper barriers and both reductions; controlled protocol deviations or incomplete candidate coverage receive partial credit only when the direction remains supported.

scientific_conclusion_rubric.statement: The analysis keeps author raw outputs, newly generated GoodVibes results, and publication comparison values distinct.
scientific_conclusion_rubric.acceptance_rule: Require archive hashes, Gaussian-to-ORCA file matching, and explicit labeling of every recomputed and publication-only quantity.

dual_axis_scoring_policy.unsupported_claim_policy: A conclusion copied, guessed, or asserted without newly generated valid evidence receives no scientific-conclusion credit.
dual_axis_scoring_policy.objective_failure_policy: A demonstrated benchmark input, framework, backend, or infrastructure failure may make the run not_scorable_objective; agent-selected invalid inputs or resource limits do not.
dual_axis_scoring_policy.invalid_submission_policy: Fabricated evidence, hidden-answer leakage, or paper values presented as new calculations make the final score zero.

critical_failures: No managed GoodVibes reanalysis was executed.
Gaussian and ORCA outputs were mismatched.
Candidate stages or protonation states were mixed in one profile.
Paper barriers were copied as recomputed values.
judge_instructions: Evaluate every hidden paper claim independently from newly generated evidence, then evaluate reproduction-process quality separately. Do not copy conclusion deficiencies into the process axis or use process quality to excuse a wrong claim. The scorer applies the multiplicative formula.

paper_reference.paper_conclusion: Successive N-protonation lowers the BiPy coupling barrier by about 10 and then 6 kcal/mol.

reference_evidence.source_boundary: Author raw outputs are visible for independent reanalysis; publication targets remain evaluator-side comparison values.
